notes: Recorded in the player's live client from an installed source-tree build of this commit (git archive, merged with main for the ForeverCore v1.8.1 pin, running against ForeverCore v1.8.1); visual_proof --compare reported no differing runtime files, the install additionally carries the ignored store icon media/icon-400.png. The character's current step is a collect step, so the guide's NPC target button (#725) was not on screen: this session shows the guide section and its Shortest Path route rows keeping their layout through repeated tracker re-layouts. The target button's row under an NPC step stays a player /reload check; tests/npc_highlight_spec.lua and tests/restedxp_actions_spec.lua cover the second-layout height.

flows.name: Guide tracker section through re-layouts
steps: /spfnear flight, so a Shortest Path route joins the guide section
